paite: TOUPA aw, migilou a pan hon humbit inla; mingongtat a pan hon hum in;
heading: David Phatna La / Humbitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

paite: amau alungtang uah thilhihkhelhte angaihtuah ua; dou ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

paite: Alei uh gul bang in ahiamsak ua; akamsung uah thangtom gu a-om hi. Selah
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, migilou-salou khut lak ah hon kemhoih inla; mingongtat lak ah hon hum in; amau ka khe kalsuante sawnkawi atum uhi.
english: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

paite: Mikisatheite'n ka awkna ding in thang aguk kam ua, khauhualte toh; lamsik ah len aphahua; ka awkna ding in thangte akam uhi. Selah
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah, nang zaw ka Pathian na hi; TOUPA aw, hehpih ka ngetna awte na bil na doh in.
english: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, ka hotdamna hatna aw, nang kisual ni chiah ka lu na hon khuhsak a,
english: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

paite: TOUPA aw, migilou-salou deihlamte zaw phal ke'nla; angaihtuahna gilou pichingsak ke'n; huchi keileh akipahtawi kha ding uhi, ka chi a. Selah
english: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

paite: Hon umsuakte lu amau muk a thugina lou agen un khuh hen.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

paite: Mei-amte atung uah kia henla; mei ah paih in om uhenla; athoh nawnlouhna ding un kokhuk thupitak ah paih in om uhen.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

paite: Thuhoih lou genpa lei ah hihkip in a-om kei ding a, mingongtat hihse ding in thil hoih lou in azong ding hi.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

paite: TOUPA'N gimthuakte agum ding chih ka thei, tagahte a ding in diktak in vai ahawm ding.
english: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

paite: Pel lou in midiktatte'n na min aphat ding ua; na ma ah midikte a-om ding uhi.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
